levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن إسحاق الدينوري

notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» (the father of Muhammad ibn Dhakwan) and «عَنْ أَبِيهِ» are bare relations (rule 7)
«وَ قَدْ أَخْرَجْتُ الطُّرُقَ» is the compiler's pointer to other routes, not a route here
Jabir is the Companion who heard the words; «كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ» is a place (rule 6)
